title: Mono Architecture
subtitle: A new perspective on the built world.
alt: Interlocking concrete architectural forms against a pale sky
description: An architectural practice imagined around a simple idea: make space for what matters. This concept pairs a confident editorial identity with a considered web experience.
approach: We built the direction around scale, space, and texture. Oversized type and generous margins give the photography room to speak, while clear navigation keeps the portfolio easy to explore.

title: Olive Wellness
subtitle: Wellbeing, with a little more personality.
alt: Olive brand identity in soft green and cream
description: A warm, optimistic identity for an imagined wellness brand. Olive moves away from perfection and makes room for a more personal, everyday approach to feeling good.
approach: An expressive symbol, a grounding green palette, and friendly typography bring the brand to life. The identity is designed to feel equally at home on packaging, a website, or a little note of encouragement.

title: Still Living
subtitle: Thoughtful spaces. Everyday moments.
alt: Light-filled living room with natural materials and soft neutral furniture
description: An imagined interior discovery platform for people who appreciate a slower pace. Still Living makes exploring thoughtful spaces feel as calm as the spaces themselves.
approach: We kept the experience simple: beautiful photography, useful details, and an intuitive path from inspiration to exploration. A quiet visual system brings consistency to every screen.

title: Form Journal
subtitle: A quieter space for creative thinking.
alt: White sculptural building beneath a pale, cloud-filled sky
description: A digital journal concept exploring architecture, design, and everyday creativity. The reading experience puts thoughtful stories and striking imagery first.
approach: A restrained grid and generous typography create a flexible editorial system. The design gives both short observations and long-form stories a comfortable place to live.
